title: Wholesome Parrots Dancing
description: Minecraft video uploaded by YouTuber Jozzo on 2019-08-02, in which a group of Minecraft parrots dance on a stage to deadman 死人's remix "Omae Wa Mou" (the "Already Dead Instrumental"), with Mr. Ender Dragon as a guest. Jozzo describes it as his rendition of the Minecraft parrot dance meme: parrots were added to Minecraft in update 1.12 on 2017-06-07 and dance when a jukebox nearby plays music, a reference to the Party Parrot meme. An earlier, shorter version by the YouTuber Сет from 2019-07-30 had little reach; Jozzo's longer and higher-quality take went viral, passed 10 million views, inspired hand-drawn and CGI animated remakes and CG5's English cover, and got its own Know Your Meme entry. The music is the entry 2017/omae_wa_mou, a remix of ShibayanRecords' "Tiny Little Adiantum".
